title: RACKWERK
prompt:
in 5 separate folders, in parallel (one agent each, model: opus):

    impress-me with a landing-page for a %usecase% using the pmndrs:examples skill

replace `%usecase%` with anything, e.g. "jewelry-boutique" | "arcade-game shop" | anything you find relevant

at the end, open each one in a browser tab
brief: Build an IMPRESSIVE 3D landing page for a modular synthesizer shop / eurorack boutique, technical-brutalist studio vibe — instancing, MeshReflectorMaterial, catmull-rom tube geometry (patch cables), studio lighting, Text3D, scroll rig, bloom/DOF. Left unfinished by the agent; the scene was there, the page around it was not, and it was completed in-repo.
